options: Only the physical tables of one database
Entities, relationships and processes within a system or organisation
The colour scheme of a reporting dashboard
The hardware specification of a server
The list of users with database access
questions.explanation: Unlike conceptual, logical and physical models that each focus on one aspect, Information Modelling represents entities, relationships and processes within a system or organisation.

questions.stem: In what order do the models typically appear when a project or solution starts?
options: Conceptual Model, then Logical Model, then Physical Model
Physical Model, then Logical Model, then Conceptual Model
Logical Model, then Physical Model, then Conceptual Model
Information Model, then Physical Model only
Physical Model only, with no other models
questions.explanation: When we start a project or solution, we begin with the Conceptual Model, then the Logical Model, then the Physical Model.

questions.stem: Why do nerd data folks hardly get in touch with Information Modelling?
options: Because it has been made obsolete by NoSQL
Because it is restricted to finance departments
Because it sits one level above creating any specific solution
Because it requires a special licence
Because it only applies to universities
questions.explanation: Information Modelling is one level above creating any special solution, which is why data practitioners rarely encounter it.

questions.stem: In the university example of Information Modelling, which entities does the Admissions conceptual model include?
options: Budget and Expenditure
Student Information and Grades
Lecturer and Classroom
Applicant and Admission Decision
Library and Book
questions.explanation: In the university example, the Admissions department's conceptual model has entities like Applicant and Admission Decision.

questions.stem: In the university example, which department's logical model details tables for Budget and Expenditure?
options: Admissions
Student Services
Library
Human Resources
Finance
questions.explanation: Finance has a logical model detailing tables for Budget and Expenditure.

questions.stem: What does the Information Modelling perspective focus on in the university example?
options: How data flows seamlessly across the departments and how their data relates
Which relational database vendor each department should buy
How to reduce the number of students admitted
The physical layout of the campus network
The salaries of departmental staff
questions.explanation: Information Modelling focuses on how data flows across departments, looking at the relationships between Applicant data in Admissions, Budget data in Finance and Student Information in Student Services.

questions.stem: Which is an example of a Process considered by Information Modelling?
options: Choosing a table's primary key
How an admitted student's information transitions from Admissions to Student Services
Defining a column's data type
Selecting an index for a table
Naming a database schema
questions.explanation: Information Modelling considers end-to-end processes involving data, such as how an admitted student's information moves from Admissions to Student Services.

questions.stem: Which kind of overarching rule does Information Modelling identify?
options: The maximum length of a table name
The order of columns in a report
Ensuring data consistency across departments or compliance with privacy regulations
The font used on invoices
The number of servers in a cluster
questions.explanation: Information Modelling identifies overarching rules, like ensuring data consistency across departments or compliance with privacy regulations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a focus of Information Modelling as described?
options: Relationships between data in different departments
End-to-end processes involving data
Overarching rules such as consistency and compliance
Choosing the specific relational database technology for one department
How information is organised, flows and is utilised within an organisation
questions.explanation: Choosing specific technology belongs to the Physical Model; Information Modelling looks at relationships, processes, rules and how information flows across the organisation.

questions.stem: In essence, what kind of view does Information Modelling provide?
options: A detailed view of one table's columns
A view limited to a single application
A snapshot of server performance
A list of user login attempts
A panoramic view of how data traverses a system or entire organisation, linking components, processes and rules
questions.explanation: Information Modelling provides a panoramic view of how data traverses a system or an entire organisation, linking components, processes and rules into a cohesive whole.
